topics.topic: Which component owns selected-instance/installation-state validation at send/start time (including header-collision checks and where instance facts are sourced)
questions: Which module performs this start-time cross-check across installation credentials and manifest required_headers for selected instances?
At send time, does service_invoker validate instance facts only from data returned by bindings, or may/should it re-read installation state itself for selected instance details?

topics.topic: Who owns assigning/validating `disclosure_class` on persisted values/outputs (FlowConstants and SpooledFile records)
questions: Which module is responsible for assigning and validating the disclosure class of FlowConstant values when they are stored (declared class from composition)?

If only those two record types are intentionally multi-writer, which module owns creating SpooledFile (M22) records and setting their semantic fields (especially disclosure_class) for function outputs versus operation outputs?

topics.topic: How cross-module refusal updates are made crash-safe so no further sends occur between `effects` refusal write and `runs` terminal-state write
questions: How is "nothing further is sent" guaranteed if a crash occurs after `effects` writes `refused_by_owner` but before `runs` writes run status `refused`?

topics.topic: What exact NodeExecution status value `effects` must persist on owner refusal
questions: When the owner refuses an effect, which NodeExecution status must `effects` write: `refused_by_owner` (A10/A11) or an A09 outcome name?

topics.topic: Whether `effects` must enforce run-not-ended preconditions itself for approval/outcome resolution, or rely on `runs` as the only entrypoint
questions: Are `effects.decide_effect_approval` / `effects.resolve_unknown_outcome` valid only when called through `runs`, or must `effects` itself enforce the run-not-ended precondition?

topics.topic: Which NodeExecution records are included in the repair view for a slot (including skipped/upstream-failed without executed implementation)
questions: Must the repair view include function-node NodeExecutions with status skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed (where executed is absent), or only records that name an executed implementation?

topics.topic: Which module decides recovery-path branching for unfinished operation elements during `runs.recover_running_runs`
questions: During `runs.recover_running_runs`, which module decides the class-dependent recovery branch for an unfinished operation element?
